courses.title: Covert Operations & Protective Surveillance
courses.description: Covert Operations & Protective Surveillance provides advanced surveillance training for protection professionals. Students learn covert observation techniques, surveillance detection, and counter-surveillance methods essential for executive protection.

courses.title: NV Armed Security Officer Certification
courses.description: Nevada Armed Security Officer Certification exceeds state requirements with comprehensive 16-hour training. This certification covers advanced firearms handling, legal responsibilities, use of force decision-making, and professional conduct standards for armed security personnel.

courses.title: Red Dot Handgun
courses.description: Red Dot Handgun training helps shooters transition from traditional iron sights to modern optical systems. Students learn dot acquisition techniques, precision shooting methods, and tactical applications for red dot equipped handguns. Training covers distances from 3 to 35+ yards.

courses.title: Protective Security Operations Certification
courses.description: Protective Security Operations Certification is designed exclusively for private security, Federal Government, DoD, and law enforcement professionals. This intensive 5-day certification program teaches contemporary skills for low visibility personal security operations in permissive to semi-permissive environments. Students learn advanced threat assessment, situational awareness, and protective methodologies used by professional agents worldwide.

courses.title: Protective Emergency Casualty Care
courses.description: Protective Emergency Casualty Care provides critical medical training specifically designed for protection agents and security professionals. Students learn trauma response, emergency medical procedures, and life-saving techniques that may be needed during security operations. This training can mean the difference between life and death.

courses.title: Intermediate Precision Rifle

courses.title: Advanced Precision Rifle
